data.one_liner: Open Sound Control (OSC) protocol implementation for Dart
data.what_it_does: It provides a simple Open Sound Control (OSC) protocol implementation for Dart. It allows encoding and decoding of OSC messages.
use_when: You need to communicate using the Open Sound Control protocol in Dart or Flutter
You are building audio or interactive applications that require OSC messaging
avoid_when: You need timestamp support, as timestamps are still todo
You require high-level networking features beyond basic OSC protocol support
strengths: Provides basic protocol support for Open Sound Control
